free_plan_covers.label: Free plan covers
free_plan_covers.help: The biggest group of monthly users a small app can serve on the free plan.

first_paid_usd_month.label: First paid plan
first_paid_usd_month.help: Monthly price of the cheapest paid plan, before usage. Empty means there is no monthly plan.

portability.label: Easy to switch away
portability.help: How much rework it takes to move to something else later.

runtime_model.label: How server code runs
runtime_model.help: Serverless code starts per request; a server stays running.

persistent_disk.label: Permanent disk
persistent_disk.help: Whether files your app writes survive restarts and redeploys.

long_lived_connections.label: Holds live connections
long_lived_connections.help: Whether your app can keep WebSocket connections open for live features.

background_workers.label: Background workers
background_workers.help: Whether an always-on process can run work outside web requests.

scheduled_jobs.label: Scheduled jobs
scheduled_jobs.help: Whether code can run on a schedule, like every night.

free_plan_commercial_use.label: Free plan allows charging customers
free_plan_commercial_use.help: Some free plans are for personal projects only.

framework_support.label: Framework support
framework_support.help: How well each framework runs on this host.

storage_model.label: Where data is kept
storage_model.help: Hosted by the provider, or a file on your own server's disk.

data_model.label: Data model
data_model.help: Tables with relations, JSON-like documents, or simple keys and values.

realtime_built_in.label: Live updates built in
realtime_built_in.help: Whether it can push changes to browsers without another service.

serverless_friendly.label: Works from serverless code
serverless_friendly.help: Whether it handles many short-lived connections without running out.

mobile_sdk.label: Mobile app SDK
mobile_sdk.help: Whether a future phone app can use it directly.

prebuilt_ui.label: Ready-made sign-in screens
prebuilt_ui.help: Whether sign-in and sign-up screens come built for you.

direct_uploads.label: Uploads go straight to storage
direct_uploads.help: Whether browsers can upload without passing files through your server.

egress_fees.label: Charges for downloads
egress_fees.help: Whether serving files to people costs money past a free amount.

merchant_of_record.label: Handles sales tax for you
merchant_of_record.help: A merchant of record is the legal seller and deals with sales tax and VAT.

subscriptions.label: Subscriptions
subscriptions.help: Whether it can charge people every month or year.

free_tier.label: Free tier
free_tier.help: Whether you can use the API without paying.

sdk_typescript.label: TypeScript SDK
sdk_typescript.help: Whether there is an official library for JavaScript and TypeScript.

cheap_model_price.label: Cheapest model price
cheap_model_price.help: The lowest-cost general text model and its token prices.

language.label: Language
language.help: The programming language you write the app in.

has_server_code.label: Can run server code
has_server_code.help: Whether the framework has a place for private, server-only code.

uses_react.label: Built with React
uses_react.help: Whether screens are written with React, the most common way to build web interfaces.

builtin_email_production_ready.label: Sends its own login emails
builtin_email_production_ready.help: Whether sign-up and password-reset emails work for a real launch without your own email service.

long_running.label: Runs long jobs
long_running.help: Whether one job can run for 10 minutes or more without being cut off.

schedules.label: Scheduled runs
schedules.help: Whether jobs can run on a schedule, like every morning.

shares_react_skills.label: Uses React
shares_react_skills.help: Whether the phone app is written with React, so React web skills carry over.

needs_mac_for_ios.label: Needs a Mac for iPhone builds
needs_mac_for_ios.help: Whether building the iPhone version requires owning a Mac.

custom_domain_free.label: Own domain on the free plan
custom_domain_free.help: Whether you can connect your own domain without paying for a plan.

free_plan_sleeps.label: Free apps fall asleep
free_plan_sleeps.help: Whether a free app pauses after a while without visitors, so the next visitor waits while it starts again.

bandwidth_included.label: Traffic included
bandwidth_included.help: How much data transfer to visitors the free and first paid plans include, and what more costs.

com_first_year_usd.label: .com, first year
com_first_year_usd.help: The price of a new .com domain for its first year, in US dollars.

com_renewal_usd.label: .com, each year after
com_renewal_usd.help: What the same .com costs to renew every year after the first, in US dollars.

whois_privacy_free.label: Privacy included
whois_privacy_free.help: Whether your name and address are hidden from public domain records at no extra cost.

dns_included.label: DNS included
dns_included.help: Whether you can point the domain at your host and email service from the same account at no extra cost.

scraper_runs.label: Runs where
scraper_runs.help: Whether a service fetches pages for you (hosted API), your code drives a browser it runs for you (hosted browser), or you run the scraper on your own server.

js_rendering.label: Pages built with JavaScript
js_rendering.help: Many sites fill in their pages with JavaScript after loading. Whether it can read those pages, and whether they cost more.

ai_ready_output.label: Clean text for AI
ai_ready_output.help: Whether it can hand back a page as clean Markdown or structured data an AI model can read directly.

price_per_1k_pages.label: Cost per 1,000 pages
price_per_1k_pages.help: Roughly what 1,000 ordinary pages cost on the first paid plan, with the math in the note.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.help: Whether it sets cookies in visitors' browsers, which affects whether you need a cookie consent banner.

product_events.label: Tracks actions in the app
product_events.help: Whether it can track what people do inside the app, like sign-ups and button clicks, not just which pages they visit.

uptime_checks.label: Uptime alerts
uptime_checks.help: Whether it checks your site from the outside and alerts you when it goes down.

session_replay.label: Session replay
session_replay.help: Whether it can record what a person did before an error, to play it back like a video.

card_fee_percent.label: Card fee, percent
card_fee_percent.help: The percent of each US card payment the service keeps.

card_fee_fixed_usd.label: Card fee, fixed
card_fee_fixed_usd.help: The fixed amount the service keeps from each US card payment, in US dollars.
